[ImNotBatman1602] Mastery #11

This was another game I played on my childhood from that GBA ROM full of NES games. The first time made decent progress, I was confused how the first maze worked and on the second, I got frustrated after running around for seemingly hours in the second-to-last level. But now, I was determined to see this story through and satisfy what my younger self couldn't have achieved.

It's a decent point-and-click adventure game and its puzzles, though sometimes challenging (as there will be moments that you'll be running around screaming "What am I supposed to do?" a lot), but they're not impossible.

I think this game is designed to prevent soft-locks as any item you need can be found before you move from chapter to chapter, so there should be no problem whatsoever to complete this (except at the end where your bag might fill up with 'key items' you cannot drop, thus necessitating a reset).

There are a lot of times where you have to move back and forth between areas to progress the chapter, but once you have completed the game, you'll have already known every story beat from front to back and can speedrun through it as fast as possible for the last achievement (I managed it in about 1 hour and 30 minutes).

Overall, it's quite a nostalgic experience as I remembered drawing out the maps for the mazes on my own and had fun fighting enemies in Finger Wars. Thank you to the developers and achievement makers for this set. I enjoyed it a lot and I hope the rest of you attempting this will do too. 😊

[kaltfront] 35
I regret nothing, everything I did was just, everyone who voted for one of the other AOTW options are the evil ones.

I can't lie and act like it's the peak of gaming. It's a fucking adventure game, with all the pitfalls. But pretty much all old adventure games have those issues - having to repeat interactions on the off-chance something different happens, 16 different action types to use all over the place, etc - at least this doesn't have a cursor for you to try using everything on every part of the screen. Ignoring all those pitfalls, this is mostly a banger. An interesting setting, some funny interactions, unexpectedly unchildish writing while still clearly being a PG game - it's a cool game.
The set has issues though, primarily Full Bag 3 aka Penitentiary Produce. Hopefully it'll be ironed out, but the cheevo is obtainable - just finnicky for now.

Tips - in general, don't be afraid to use a guide. It's still an old adventure game, you'll save yourself a lot of time and nerves. If you're aiming for a mastery, for your first playthrough do not buy any juices in chapter 2, buying them is incompatible with a few cheevos down the line, and you can get everything past it in one playthrough, so once you've beaten the game, you only have to redo chapter 2 for Full Bag 2 aka Saladoria's Cornucopia. In chapter 7 you can help Yam and Asparagus while also getting A Fistful of Lettuce without lucking out with an Octoberry spawn - ignore Spices, for some reason they're not necessary.
The fights that require you to win flawlessly, whether for an achievement or story reasons, all have an abusable pattern of some kind. Especially Minister Pumpkin - losing against him is a game over, meaning you'll have to restart the whole game if you're aiming for the no passwords cheevo, so don't lose. You can find info about those patterns in-game, but if you don't figure it out, the guide also tells you.
Most importantly - have fun. It's a silly game.

For the set, you should start by getting all the items you can except for the juice in Chapter 2, since there are two achievements you can only get by skipping that. I then did a second playthrough starting from Chapter 2 to the early part of Chapter 7. I think you can actually skip ahead to Chapter 6 if you just need Needy for Nutrients though, since you can find enough coins in Bananda's cave and get gold from selling carrots. I don't really like the achievement for finishing the entire game in one run, it's not something these adventure games benefit from, especially since password saves provide no advantage and you'd still need to finish every chapter to get the Beaten status. It's not a super long game, about 2-3 hours with a guide, but I started playing it late at night so I was getting tired by the end.

There are a couple good online guides for this game, I used a combination of the 2010 GameFAQs one, U Can Beat Video Games on YouTube, and the Classic Games Paradise article. Still, this is a great candidate for an RA Guide entry.

An interesting early(ish) adventure game. The menu system makes it somewhat less annoying than cursor-based games in this genre from this era, but it can still be frustratingly obtuse if you're used to more modern adventure games, especially with how arbitrary it can be. The "combat" is neat, but every enemy being represented the exact same way with the same dinky music takes me out of scenes that are supposed to be a bit more serious (not that this is a particularly serious game, but still). I'd recommend checking this out if you're interested in the genre, just be prepared to pull up a guide when you get sick of bashing your head against a wall.

I think this set does a good job of showcasing most of what the game has to offer, though the "beat the game without passwords" achievement just seems unnecessary (and kind of mean, considering the only place where your run can actually end is the penultimate fight). Having to replay one or two chapters because of incompatible missables is also a bit weird IMO, though not that big of a deal considering how fast you can get them on a replay.

Welcome to the Salad Kingdom!  This land was once a place where fruits and
veggies lived in peace and happiness, but recently a dubious turn of events has
has thrown the kingdom into dischord.  As the valiant knight Sir Cucumber, you
must rescue the kidnapped Princess Tomato from the castle of the nefarious
Minister Pumpkin and restore peace to the Salad Kingdom.  A long, treacherous
journey awaits...


P R I N C I P A L   C H A R A C T E R S :


~ KING BROCCOLI:  The Salad Kingdom's wise and benevolent ruler.  Overcome with
  grief over the kidnapping of his daughter, Princess Tomato, the king passed
  away.


~ PRINCESS TOMATO:  King Broccoli's lovely daughter who is adored by many.


~ MINISTER PUMPKIN:  Once a trusted consort to the king, this power-hungry
  brute now attempts to overthrow the monarchy and claim the Salad Kingdom for
  himself.


~ SIR CUCUMBER:  The king's brave and faithful knight.  Sir Cucumber is always
  willing to help those in need.


~ PERCY:  A loyal friend and right-hand man to Sir Cucumber.


~ FARMIES:  Cruel henchmen sent out by Minister Pumpkin to terrorize the
  kingdom's citizens.


~ PRINCE LETTUCE:  A leader of the resistance against Minister Pumpkin, and
  younger brother of Princess Tomato.

~ LISA:  The princess' human sister and a key member of the resistance.

                     `        C H A P T E R   1 :        `
                     *                                   *
                     `     T H E   A D V E N T U R E     `
                     *         C O M M E N C E S         *
                     `                                   `
                     *`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*


Take the red flower in the road for good luck and move forward to the celery
forest.  The baby persimmon sitting on the path is in need of water, so you'll
need to find him some.  Move forward to the intersection and check the
signpost.  Move to Lake Quench and take some water, then go back to the celery
forest and give water to the persimmon.  Now talk to the persimmon and he'll
join you on your quest.  Select the LOOK command to exit the close-up of Percy.

PERCY:  You can now use the Percy command to get helpful information and advice
from your new companion.

Go forward again to the intersection and now move to the melon patch to help
Percy's friends.  Check the bush near the fence, then move there to discover
Prince Lettuce.  You need to revive the prince with water in order to speak to
him.  He reveals that there's a passage under the fence which leads to the
melon patch.  Move to the passage now and give water to the dried up melons.
Talk to the melons and you'll receive a gate pass.  Return to the intersection
and move to the town gate.  Use the pass, which won't work.  Seems you'll have
to find another way to get past the guard.  Return to Lake quench and look to
discover a nest in the tree.  Check the nest to find a gold coin.  Now move
forward to the shrine and give the flower to the statue.  Use the Percy command
to get a helpful hint about the gate guard.  Return to the gate now and sneak
past the sleeping guard into the town.

text:
Note: At the end of each chapter, Percy will lose any unnecessary items.

                     `         S A L A D O R I A         `
                     *                                   *

                     *`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*`*


Take a look around at Orange Park.  Speak with the garlic to learn about an
old scholar who lives on the mountain.  Talk to him again and he'll demand
coffee.  Check the fountain for coins, then talk to Percy to learn that if
you hit the fountain just right, coins pop out.  Hit the fountain a few times
until you get a coin, then be sure to take it with you.  Move to the mountain-
side and speak with Mr. Corn to get some info about exchanging gold coins for
Saladorian currency.  Return to Orange Park, then go to Main Street.  If you
ever see Octoberry go by here, be sure to check the street for coins.  Now
go to and the antique shop.  Speak with the clerk and talk to Percy, who
suggests coming back later.  Next go to the coffee shop and buy a cup with the
coin you got from the fountain.  Talk to Lady Plum a few times to learn about a
shady waiter at the cabaret.  Return to the antique shop and speak with the
clerk again to receive a letter, which you should deliver to Miss Peachy at the
deli.  As a reward, she'll give you a sandwich.  Return to Mr. Pear at
the antique shop and speak with him to have your gold coins exchanged for
Saladorian coins.  At this point, if ever need more coins, go to the mountain-
side and take some clover; you can sell it at the antique shop for money.

Go to Orange Park and give the coffee to the garlic, who will demand a donut.
Talk to him again and he'll say that you can get a donut from the cabaret.
Return to Main Street and check the strip, then move to the Cabaret Celery.
Enter the cabaret, which will cost you a coin.  Inside, check the waiter and
speak with him a few times and he'll tell you he wants you to meet someone in
the restroom.  Move there and check the trash can a couple times to find a
donut; take it with you.  Stop by the juice shop and buy some grape juice,
which you'll need a bit later on in the game.  Feel free to check out the
electronics shop, but the chestnut who works there isn't the friendliest.

When you return to Orange Park, you'll find a different wanderer and a child.
Speak to the child to learn he's hungry, then give him the sandwich.  Now talk
to the soursop wanderer and learn about the secret resistance base.  Go speak
with Mr. Corn on the mountain again to learn about the pharmacy near the
cabaret.  Return to the cabaret and talk to Percy to get a good piece of advice.
Praise the barker and he'll tell you where the pharmacy is.  At the pharmacy,
talk to Mr. Fig a couple times to receive the aspirin.  Head back to Orange
Park and buy a flower from the flower girl.  Now talk to her and learn about
the bookshop near the park.  Enter the shop, look around and speak with the
clerk.  If you consult Percy, he'll tell you he thinks the clerk is working for
the enemy.  Hit the clerk and he'll run away, then hit the register and take
the coin from inside.  Now check the counter and take the key you find there.
Try to leave the bookshop and you'll be captured by the farmies.

Check the inmates then talk to them.  If you consult Percy, he'll point a
finger of suspicion at Potato.  Hit Potato then talk to him to receive a file.
Use the file and you'll be taken to the interrogation room.  Talk to Lt. Pepper
a few times until he discovers your file, which you'll need to surrender to
him.  In the torture room, check the door a few times to discover a rusty hole.
Use the hit command twice on the door; Lt. Pepper will leave.  Hit the door
once more and check it to discover a keyhole.  Use the key from your inventory
on the keyhole to make your escape.

In the hallway, look at the jail a couple times to discover the garlic
wanderer.  Talk to him and give him the donut you've been holding onto.
Unfortunately, he's forgotten the info he had for you, so come back later.
You can hit the alarm on the wall to set it off but you'll eventually be re-
captured and taken back to the torture room.  If this happens, check the room
thoroughly to find the key that will let you out.

Back at the jail, move to the right once and you'll be standing outside Lt.
Pepper's office. To the right again is a storage room, in which you can find
rope and a few other items.  Get the rope then exit and return to the jail door.
Talk to the garlic to receive a soap grenade.  Now move right, to Lt. Pepper's
office.  Try to enter the room and you'll get a warning from Percy.  Enter the
room again and use the fake grenade to scare the lieutenant.  Now use the rope
to restrain him.  Leave the office then move to the right and reenter the
storage room.  Take the lantern from inside, then exit the storage room and
exit the police station.  Use the lantern to disguise yourself, then leave the
police station yard.

At the Spinach Heights intersection, move first to Lake Quench and take some
water.  If you check the nest, the fern birds will return and reveal a nest of
baby birds.  You may revisit the apple shrine and consult Percy to learn a
helpful tidbit about an upcoming enemy.  Return to the passage at the melon
patch and you'll find Watermelon there alone.  Rehydrate him with water then
talk to him.  Go back to Lake Quench and find the umbrella by checking the bush
again.  Return to the melon patch passage and check the 3rd hole twice to find
the mole hole.  Use the umbrella to get the mole to come out.  Talk to the mole
then give him some water.  Talk to him some more and you'll receive info about
Saladron, plus the left half of some instructions.  Move back and talk to
Watermelon again.  Now move to the forest guard's shack and move forward to
find a stream behind it.  You won't be able to cross the stream yet because
Percy can't swim, so return to the shack.  Consult Percy and Mr. Leek will
appear.  Give him his umbrella and you'll receive a pair of water wings.  Use
the wings at the stream and you'll be able to cross safely.  You'll now run
into a farmie, which you'll want to fight.

source_title: Walkthrough by Ashlar79
text:
BATTLE:  Combat in the game takes the form of Rock, Paper, Scissors.  Here's
how what each direction on the control pad will select:

Up:    Rock
Left:  Scissors
Right: Paper
Down:  Rock

Once you beat your opponent at Rock, Paper, Scissors, you'll need to correctly
guess which direction in which the enemy will look.  The farmie will always
look down, so press down on the control pad.  Different enemies have different
quirks during battle, so try to learn them in order to have an edge.  If you
happen to lose at the Rock, Paper, Scissors phase, you'll have to try to look
away from the direction your enemy points.  Losing this will mean having to
go another round against the enemy.

The Parsley Forest is a maze you'll have to navigate through.  Collect the
compass, tin can, shovel and gold found in the maze as you make your way to
Saladron's lair.

		      T H E   P A R S L E Y   F O R E S T


	N	    C       $             T		Legend:
      W + E	E X X X   L X X X         X		E = Entrance
	S	    X           X     $   X		C = Compass
		  $ X X X       X X X X   X		$ = Coin
		    X           X     X   X		T = Tin can
		    X   X X     X   S X   X		S = Shovel
		    X     X     X         X		L = Saladron's lair
		    X X X X X X X X X X X X
                    X


Once you reach the lair, use the tin can on the tree to summon Saladron.
Battle the beast the same way you did the farmie, but this time you'll have to
win three times to vanquish the enemy.  Remember the tip you discovered at the
shrine earlier--always select scissors, or left.  This will make beating
Saladron a cinch.  Now move into the scary tree and check the vicity a couple
times to find a mount of dirt near the altar.  Use the shovel to dig up the
mound until you find the medal.  Check the medal then take it with you.  Now
exit the tree and find Mr. Leek outside.  Talk to him to end the chapter; if
you didn't buy grape juice earlier, he'll give you some.

Enter the base and move forward; you'll hear people talking from inside a room.
Move into the room, which is the resistance meeting room.  Use the medal to
prove you're a member of the resistance.  Now talk to the troops and you'll
meet Lisa, Princess Tomato's human sister.  Give the aspirin to Lisa then go
back.  Exit the meeting room then reenter.  Move to see Lisa and talk to her;
you'll have a short meeting with the leader of the resistance, General
Cantaloupe, and receive the resistance crest.  Now exit back to the hallway and
go to the door on the right.  Enter the room, which is Lisa's room.  Talk to
her to learn about a pendant she lost while cleaning her room.

Exit the base and check the box twice to find the pendant hidden in a banana
skin.  Give the pendant to Lisa and talk to her.  Leave her room and go back to
the hallway; move to the room on the left.  Talk to Grapy the guard and give
him your grape juice.  Now return to Lisa's room and talk to her to gain access
to the arms room.  Go back to the arms room, which Grapy was guarding, and have
a look inside.  Take a nut bomb and head back to the meeting room.  Look at the
troops and speak with each of them; you'll learn of a monster called Bananda
whose cave is near Peanut Village.

Check the bottles lying around the tomb, then consult Percy to find a note in
one of the bottles.  Move forward into the village and speak with the chief and
his wife as much as you can.  Now check the vicinity and move to the park.
Check the lawn to find a coin.  Talk to the 3 park-goers and learn about the
convenience store and the Carrot hermit.  Check the statue and the cryptic
characters.  Move to the convenience store and buy a wordbook and some squid.
Now go back to the park and move to the hermit's house.  Give him the squid and
he'll tell you to get a lantern from the village chief.  Use the wordbook at
the park to decipher the message on the statue.  Go back to the village
entrance and move to Carrot Plateau.  Here, check the vicinity to discover
carrots, which you can take and sell at the convenience store if you need

In the next part of the hallway, turn left to get to the garden.  You'll see
that the princess isn't here, so go back inside.  Now turn right and you'll
spot a guard sleeping around the corner.  The guard will prevent you from going
any further for the moment.  Go back to the shower and hit it again to summon

water from the pond, then move back to the hallway and turn right again.  Use
the ornament to get the guard's attention, then use the oil pot.  Now use the
chain to tie up the guard.

You'll now be at a jail cell door.  The door is locked, so look around and check
the hallway till you find a set of keys.  Unlock the door and enter the cell.
Look at the vegetables and show them the crest.  Talk to the vegetables.  Give a
gold coin to Bell Pepper and remember the sequence he tells you; he'll also
mention a dangerous family of monsters living in the castle basement.  Now look
again at the cell and you'll see a barrel.  Check the barrel a couple of times
to notice a white leaf.  Check the leaf then give him some water.  Talk to the
leaf and show him the crest.  Talk to Lord White Leaf again and he'll share a
bit of important info about Minister Pumpkin's son.  Now check Lettuce a couple
times until you find a caterpillar.  Be sure to take it with you.  

Exit back to the far hallway and enter the door on the near left.  You'll see
the sleeping chamber maid in this room.  Enter the door on the right and check
everything in the room.  When you check the bed, you'll notice it's warm, as if

on the near left.  This time when you enter the room, the maid will be gone.
Move right to the next room, then right again into a dressing room.  Look
around and check all the items in the room.  Hit the stool a couple times and
then check it twice; check the diary you find.  Exit back to the hallway and
re-enter the maid's room.  Go through the door on the right and you'll see a
woman sitting on the bed.  Talk to the old woman a couple of times and show her

couple of times then exit back to the hallway.

**Princess Tomato in the Salad Kingdom** (サラダの国のトマト姫, __Sarada no Kuni no Tomato Hime__[?](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Japanese "wikipedia:Help:Japanese")) is an adventure game by [Hudson Soft](/wiki/Hudson_Soft "Hudson Soft") originally released in [1984](/wiki/1984 "1984") for the [NEC PC-8801](/wiki/NEC_PC-8801 "NEC PC-8801"), [NEC PC-6001](/wiki/NEC_PC-6001 "NEC PC-6001"), [Fujitsu FM-7](/wiki/Fujitsu_FM-7 "Fujitsu FM-7"), and [MSX](/wiki/MSX "MSX") Japanese home computers. On May 27, 1988, it was ported to the [Famicom](/wiki/Famicom "Famicom"). It was then translated and published on February 8, 1991 for the [NES](/wiki/NES "NES") in North America. It was also released on the [Wii](/wiki/Wii "Wii")'s [Virtual Console](/wiki/Virtual_Console "Virtual Console") in Japan on January 19, 2010 and in North America on February 8, 2010.

## Story

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Princess_Tomato_in_the_Salad_Kingdom&veaction=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Story") | [edit source](/w/index.php?title=Princess_Tomato_in_the_Salad_Kingdom&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Story")]

"Many growing seasons ago, there was a place where vegetables lived happily, and in perfect harmony. One day, Minister Pumpkin betrayed King Broccoli. He kidnapped Princess Tomato and stole the Turnip Emblem. He took them to his castle in the Zucchini Mountains. He sent his cruel Farmies out to terrorize all the vegetables in the Salad Kingdom. Shortly thereafter, the poor King died from the loss of his beautiful daughter. But he promised you, brave Sir Cucumber, the Princess' hand and the kingdom if you bring them back safely. God speed Sir Cucumber! Hurry! Saladoria is down this path. The Zucchini Mountains are over yonder." 

The characters are primarily cartoon-like anthropomorphic fruit and vegetables. Taking the role of Sir Cucumber, a knight, the player is assigned by King Broccoli (now deceased) to defeat the evil Minister Pumpkin who has kidnapped Princess Tomato. Early on, Sir Cucumber gains a sidekick, Percy the baby persimmon, who offers advice and helps throughout the quest (and always calls Sir Cucumber "Boss").

## Gameplay

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Princess_Tomato_in_the_Salad_Kingdom&veaction=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Gameplay") | [edit source](/w/index.php?title=Princess_Tomato_in_the_Salad_Kingdom&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Gameplay")]

_Princess Tomato in the Salad Kingdom_ plays similarly to a text adventure, though due to the NES's lack of a keyboard accessory, the possible commands are represented by buttons which line both sides of the screen. The commands are fixed and do not change during gameplay. Primarily, the game consists of still screens with the exception of the "finger wars", mazes and occasional animated character, such as the octoberry and fern birds.

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Princess_Tomato_in_the_Salad_Kingdom&veaction=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Remix version") | [edit source](/w/index.php?title=Princess_Tomato_in_the_Salad_Kingdom&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Remix version")]

Giovani Akira Faganello in association with Pixeltemple has created a PHP/HTML fan version of Princess Tomato in the Salad Kingdom called "Princess Tomato in the Salad Kingdom - REMIX". This version, which is currently offline, has updated graphics for the first level, and are made to match the original game graphics. Graphics for all other levels are the same as the original NES version and it mostly retains the same dialog from the original game.

Starting point | Cucumber Soldier (you) | Take the Flower (optional) | The story is told. You have three gold coins. You may pick up the flower if you like.   
Celery Forest | Percy | Talk | Percy is thirsty   
Lake Quench |  | Look | There is a fern bird's nest in the tree.   
Check the Nest | You will find a gold coin in the nest that you can take.   
Take the Coin   
Take the Water | You will store up to three drinks of water in a pot.   
Lake Quench shrine |  | Give the Flower (optional) | If you like, you may place the flower in front of the shrine.   
Celery Forest | Percy | Give Water | Percy looks relieved.   
Talk ×2 | Percy tells you that his friends have been captured and need help.   
Look | Percy will join you.   
Parsley Forest |  | Look | Cherry birds will fly by.   
Check the bush | If Percy is with you, he will notice someone underneath the bush.   
Inside the bush | Prince Lettuce | Give water | Prince Lettuce will look relieved.   
Talk | Prince Lettuce will ask you to use the passage to help his friends in the Melon Patch.   
Melon Patch | Nappa, Cantalop, Hon Dew, Wat Mel | Give water | All four melons will be revived.   
Talk to Cantalop | You will receive a pass to enter Saladoria Town.   
Town entrance | Guard | Give Pass | The guard will notice you don't look like the picture and take the pass away.   
Percy | Percy tells you that the guard sometimes falls asleep.   
Go back and return | Keep leaving and returning until you catch the guard asleep.   
Move: Advance | You will enter the town. Percy will drop all unnecessary items.

## Progress

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Princess_Tomato_in_the_Salad_Kingdom/Chapter_2&veaction=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Progress") | [edit source](/w/index.php?title=Princess_Tomato_in_the_Salad_Kingdom/Chapter_2&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Progress")]

Location | Appearance | Command | Description   
---|---|---|---  
Orange Park | Garlic wanderer |  | This is the starting point in Saladoria Town   
Mt. Side | Mr. Corn | Talk ×2 | He will mention that you can trade gold for coins at the antique shop.   
Antique Shop | Mr. Pear |  | Mr. Pear won't say anything special until you leave and come back.   
Antique Shop | Mr. Pear | Talk ×2 | Now he will ask if you will do him a favor, and deliver a letter to Miss Peachy at the Deli.   
Deli | Miss Peachy | Give the Letter | Miss Peachy will thank you for delivering the letter by giving you a sandwich in return.   
Antique Shop | Mr. Pear | Talk ×2 | Once you delivered his letter, he will agree to exchange your gold coins for Saladoria coins.   
Main Street | Octoberry | Check the Street | When you notice an Octoberry crawl across the street, check the street to find a coin and then pick it up.   
Take the Coin   
Coffe Shop | Mrs. Plum | Buy a Coffee | Purchase a cup of coffee with your Saladorian coins. Mrs. Plum will mention that they are out of donuts.  
(In the Japanese version, this was a cigarette shop. You had to buy a pack of cigarettes, but they were out of matches.)   
Orange Park | Garlic Wanderer | Give the Coffee | He will appreciate the coffee (cigarettes) and ask for a donut (matches).   
Talk ×2 | After asking for a donut (matches), he will suggest that you might find some at the Cabaret, and that he'll have news for you when you return.   
Main Street |  | Check the Strip | Now you will notice that there's a Cabaret at the far end of the shops.   
Cabaret Celery | Mr. Scallion | Move to enter | You will be charged one coin to enter.   
Inside Cabaret Celery | Miss Apricot  
Miss Lemon  
Banana Boy (waiter) | Talk to Waiter ×3 | He will mention that he wants you to meet someone in the restroom.   
Move to the Restroom | You will give the waiter a one coin tip.   
Restroom |  | Check the Trash ×2 | After checking the trash can a bit, you will find a donut (matches). Pick it up before you leave.   
Take the Donut   
Orange Park | Soursop Wanderer  
Soursop Child | Give the Sandwich | The child will stop crying from hunger and become very happy.   
Talk to Wanderer | Since you cheered up the child, he will wake up his father so that you can speak with him. He will tell you that he was once a minister, and that he is seeking to establish a base for a resistance movement in the Parsley Forest. After this, however, he will resume sleeping on the bench and ask you to speak to the old man again.   
Mt. Side | Mr. Corn | Talk ×2 | Mr. Corn tells you that the resistance leader is suffering from a headache, and that you should find the pharmacy to get medicine.   
Celery Cabaret | Mr. Scallion | Praise | After complimenting Mr. Scallion, he will tell you where the Pharmacy is located.   
Pharmacy | Mr. Fig | Talk ×2 | Mr. Fig will not hesitate to give you aspirin to cure the resistance leader's headache, and suggests that the leader may invite you to join.   
Orange Park | Miss Cauliflower | Buy a Flower | The flower girl will thank you, and be more open to speak with you.   
Talk ×2 | She will tell you about a bookshop on the other side of the park that is a contact place for the Resistance.   
Bookshop | Simon | Hit Simon | This strange shopkeeper claims to know nothing, and will flee from the shop if you hit him, giving you a better chance to snoop around.   
| Check the Counter | You will find a key. Take the key, and then exit the shop. When you step outside, government officials will be waiting for you an arrest you. At this time, Percy will drop any unnecessary items that you may have been holding.   
Take the Key   
Exit the shop

## Progress

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Princess_Tomato_in_the_Salad_Kingdom/Chapter_3&veaction=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Progress") | [edit source](/w/index.php?title=Princess_Tomato_in_the_Salad_Kingdom/Chapter_3&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Progress")]

Location | Appearance | Command | Description   
---|---|---|---  
Inside a prison | Sprout  
Potato  
Turnip  
Mushroom | Examine the inmates | You learn the identities of the other vegetables who have been captured.   
Hit the Potato | Potato will refuse to offer any useful advice until you get tough with him.   
Talk to Potato | He will give you a file.   
Use the File | You attempt to use the file to escape from the jail, but you get caught in the process and get taken to the interrogation room.   
Interrogation Room | Sgt. Pepper | Talk ×3 | Sgt. Pepper will ask you about the bookshop and being resistance members before he will notice that Percy is holding something, and turn red with anger.   
Give the File | Realizing that you were trying to use the file to escape, he will lock you up in a torture room which is slowly filling up with water.   
Torture Room | Sgt.Pepper | Check the door ×2 | At first, the door will seem flawless, but upon closer inspection, you will find a small hole.   
Hit the door ×3 | The first hit won't do anything, but the second one will convince Sgt. Pepper that you are assuredly trapped, and he will walk away. A third hit will indicate that the door rattled.   
Check the door | This time, you will discover that there's a keyhole in the door.   
Use the key | The key that you obtained from the bookshop will successfully open this door, and you can escape.   
Prison door |  | Look insde the Jail | You will notice someone inside. It's dark, so it will take a second look to discover that it's the Garlic Wanderer from earlier.   
Give the Donut (matches) | He will be grateful for the item, but he will be unable to recall whatever it was that he wanted to tell you in the first place.   
Closet door |  |  | When you come to the door that has a fire extinguisher outside of it, enter inside.   
Closet |  | Take the Rope | There are a number of items in the closet, but the rope is the only one that you need.   
Prison door |  | Talk to Garlic ×2 | The Garlic wanderer will give you a fake grenade that he carved out of a piece of soap.   
Office door |  | Enter the room ×2 | The first time you open it, you will realize that someone is inside. If you insist and enter the room anyway, you will find Mr. Pepper inside.   
Pepper's office | Sgt. Pepper | Use the Grenade | Upon showing Sgt. Pepper the grenade, you will fool him into thinking that it's real, and scare him into submission.   
Use the Rope | Once he is scared, you can tie him up so that he can't interfere with your escape from prison.   
Closet |  | Take the Lantern | The next time you visit the closet, you will notice a lantern that you didn't see before.   
Exit | Guards | Use the Lantern | By making use of the lantern, you will resemble the guards just enough to blend in with the crowd.   
Move to go out | Blending in with the guards will make it possible for you to escape without getting caught. Percy will drop some unnecessary items while running away.

Location | Appearance | Command | Description   
---|---|---|---  
Spinach Heights |  |  | After you escape from the prison, you will return to this familiar crossroads.   
Lake Quench |  | Take water | Be sure to restock some water.   
Check the Bush ×2 | The first time you check, you will be distracted by the fern birds. Check again, and you will notice a blue umbrella. Grab it before you return to the crossroads.   
Take the umbrella   
Behind the fence | Wat Mel | Give Water | Wat Mel will need to be revived before he can talk.   
Talk | Wat Mel will explain that everyone else was harvested. He mentions that Mr. Leek lost a blue umbrella.   
Check 3rd Hole ×2 | This hole is deeper than the others, and turns out to be a mole hole.   
Mole hole |  | Use Umbrella | By creating some shade, a mole will appear.   
Mole | Give water | By giving water to the mole, he will tell you about the monster in the forest who is protecting the Yam Medallion.   
Talk ×3 | Mole will warn you about a monster. Then he will give you the left half of some instructions. Finally, he will tell you to find the Forest Guard.   
Behind the fence | Wat Mel | Talk | Wat Mel will explain the Mr. Leek is the Forest Guard, and point the way to his shack.   
Shack |  |  | When you arrive, the area will be deserted.   
River |  |  | You will find a river, but if you attempt to cross, Percy will explain that he needs water wings to make it. Head back to the shack.   
Shack |  | Percy | Speak with Percy and he will call out to see if anyone is home. Mr. Leek will appear in front of you.   
Mr. Leek | Talk | You can speak multiple times to Mr. Leek, but he won't reveal much useful information, and ultimately forget what he needs to tell you.   
Give Umbrella | Giving Mr. Leek his umbrella will prompt him to give Percy water wings in return. Now you can cross the river.   
Beyond the river | Farmie | Fight | When you cross the river, you will encounter a Farmie. You will not be able to escape from him. The only way to get away is to defeat him in a battle of Finger Wars. This will be your first battle. In truth, it is a very easy battle. If you manage to beat him in the Rock-Paper-Scissors portion, he will always look down, so always choose down to beat him.   
**Parsley Forest Maze**  
[](/wiki/File:PTitSK_Ch4_maze.png) | This is your first maze. You begin at the bottom by the yellow **S** , and you must ultimately make your way to the yellow **G**. Along the way, there are several items for you to collect, some of which are important. 

  * Immediately after you enter the maze, turn left and enter the dead-end. You will find the compass, which will make it easier to tell which way you are travelling through the maze.
  * There are five pouches that you can find, three of which contain gold while the other two are empty.
  * Travel all the way up to the north portion of the maze, and then head west until you reach a dead-end. You will find a tin can there which you will need.
  * Then turn around, go back to the east, and then south until you can turn right and go west again. Follow the path as it spirals around to the right until you find a shovel.
  * Once you have the tin can and the shovel, make your way to the goal.

Sacred Tree |  | Use the Tin Can | Throwing the Tin Can inside the tree will awaken the monster known as Saladron.   
Saladron | Fight | The fight against Saladron is even easier than the fight with the Farmie. Saladron always chooses paper, so you should always choose scissors. Then you just have to correctly guess which way he will look to score a point.   
Inside the tree |  | Check Vicinity ×2 | First you will notice a shrine, but the second time, you will also notice a mound of dirt.   
Use Shovel ×6 | It will take six full uses of the shovel to unearth the object that is buried beneath the mound of dirt.   
Check Medal | You must first examine the medal you find to confirm that it is the Yam Medallion.   
Take Medallion | Now you may claim the medallion and leave the tree.   
Sacred Tree | Mr. Leek | Talk | Mr. Leek will thank you for defeating Saladron and reclaiming the Yam Medallion. He will agree to take you to the resistance base, and he will give you a bottle of grape juice. Percy will, as usual, drop any useless items along the way.

Base entrance |  | Look | Look at the scene and you will notice the boxes.

Location | Appearance | Command | Description

Carrot Plateau |  |  | You will begin the next chapter at this location. Move forward.   
Peanut Village entrance | Village Chief and wife | Talk to the chief and wife (alternating) ×2 | To get the clearest picture of what's going on, talk to the dad and the mom back and forth until they simply cry over the kidnapping of their daughter.   
Peanut Village entrance |  | Check Vicinity | To continue in the adventure, you must leave the entrance, and then return. When you do, if you check the vicinity, you will notice the village chief's home and a park.   
Chief's house | Village Chief | Talk ×2 | The chief tells you that his daughter was taken into a cave, and that the cave entrance can be found near Carrot Plateau.   
Cave entrance |  | Move to enter | You will find that the cave is too dark to continue, and that you must retreat.   
Peanut Park | Shroom  
Peasha  
Peaja | Check the grass | If you examine the grass, you will find and collect a gold coin.   
Look | By examining the scenary, you will see the three inhabitants of the park.   
Talk to Peaja | Peaja will tell you to go visit the Hermit who lives next to the park.   
Talk to Shroom | Shroom will tell you to visit the convenience store on the other side of the park.   
Convenience store | Peanut clerk | Buy some squid | All other items in the store are unnecessary, except for the wordbook if you wish to read the characters below the statue in the park.  
(Note: If you need more money, return to Carrot Plateau, Take a carrot, and Give the carrot to the clerk for one coin.)   
Hermit's home | Carrot hermit | Give the squid | The hermit is hungry and will be very happy to receive some squid. He will tell you to get Percy to ask the village chief for a lamp, and to return when Bananda is defeated.   
Chief's house | Village Chief | Percy | Percy will be better able to communicate your need for a lamp, and the chief will provide you with one.   
Cave entrance |  |  | Now that you have a lamp, you may enter.

| Take banana skin ×5 | You will have to take skin continuously until you discover Nutty underneath.   
Nutty | Talk | Nutty will be grateful for rescuing her. She will ask you to take her hom.

text:
* There are five pouches here, all of which contain one gold coin. Collecting them is really optional.
  * Your true goal is to reach the opposite end of the maze (**G**), where you will find the entrance to the Dice-O-Matic.

  
Dice-O-Matic entrance |  | Use the Yam Medallion | The medallion fits the indentation in the door which unlocks it and allows you to enter.   
Cockpit |  | Use the battery | You must first attempt to use the battery before you can see where to use it.   
Check the vicinity | You will find the location where the battery must be placed.   
Use the battery | Putting the battery in place will provide power to the Dice-O-Matic.   
Hit the lever ×2 | After striking the level, the Dice-O-Matic will power up and begin moving.   
Carrot Plateau |  | Advance ×3 | You will see the same scene for a while before something happens.   
War Melon army | Advance | Once you see the enemies, you must still advance to confront them.   
Enemy | Fight | Once again, you will be locked in a battle of Finger Wars. The enemy usually alternates between looking right and left, so if you beat them at Rock-Paper-Scissors, be sure to choose left or right, and never up or down.   
Minister Pumpkin | Fight | After defeating the regular enemies, you must face Minister Pumpkin in a Finger Wars fight. Like the previous enemies, the minister only ever looks left or right, although with less predictability than the previous enemy. Use this knowledge to your advantage and cut the fight as short as possible. If you succeed, your Dice-O-Matic will break down, and the minister will get away.   
Giant Tree |  | Check the vicinity | You will be standing in front of the large tree.   
Check the tree | You will examine the tree more closely.   
Check the tree parts | Something will slip and fall to the ground.   
Check the roots | You will notice strange grass on the ground.   
Take the strange grass | The grass will flash in different colors.   
Check the ground | You will find the right half portion of the instructions that the mole gave to you.   
Take the instructions | Now you can read the entire message.   
Check the instructions | They will tell you to use the strange grass.   
Use the strange grass ×2 | The first time you use the grass, you and Percy will transform into various kinds of food. Percy will realize that the grass transforms you into whatever you were thinking about. He suggests that you transform into Farmies the next time you use the grass. By doing so, you will advance to the next chapter.

Aspara  
Squash | Check left store | It is the General Store   
Check right store | It is the bar.

Bar | George  
Dan  
Radish Ron | Check the customers | Seated at the bar are George, Dan, and Radish Ron. George and Dan are Farmies, but Ron works for the resistance.   
Talk to George | He praises Minister Pumpkin.   
Talk to Dan | He welcomes you as Farmies.   
Talk to Ron | He mentions how dangerous it is to be a resistance member.   
Bar | George  
Dan  
Radish Ron | Talk to George | You'll have to exit the bar and reenter to get some different responses. George will be asleep.   
Talk to Dan | Dan seems to be getting drunk.   
Talk to Ron ×2 | Ron tells you that George and Dan work for Minister Pumpkin, and that the Princess is being held in the castle.   
Bar | George  
Dan  
Radish Ron | Use the Crest | If you try to use the crest before entering the pub a third time, it will do you no good.   
Talk to Ron ×2 | Ron will be aware enough now to know that you are resistance members. He tells you that he found a key to a room in the castle. Since you're on your way there, he gives the key to you.   
Main Street | Yam  
Aspara  
Squash | Talk to Squash | He will ask if you're really Farmies   
Use Crest | Squash will realize that you're really resistance members, and he will tell you to explore Pea Street for more information. Alternatively, you can buy juice at the general store and give it to Aspara, or buy bread and give it to Yam, to open access to Pea Street.   
Pea Street | E. P.  
D. R. | Check the Wanderers | You will see that it is E. P. and D. R. who are waiting by the corner.   
Talk to D.R. | He won't be too interested in talking to you.   
Use Crest | Now D. R. will be more interested in speaking with you.   
Talk to D. R. | He will tell you that someone dug a passage halfway to the castle, and that you should get more information from the old lady who lives around the corner.   
House | Old Lady | Talk to the old lady | Upon learning that you've met the Carrot Hermit, she will be impressed that you've come so far.   
Give Medicine | If you check her, Percy will say she appears ill. Give the medicine to her, and she will recover.   
Talk to the old lady ×4 | The old lady will confirm that a passage has indeed been dug to the castle. She will advise you to bring a tool because it's incomplete. D. R. | Talk to E.P. | E. P. claims that he can help you, but that it will cost some gold.   
Use all of your gold | Regardless of how much gold you are carrying, E. P. will not provide you with anything until you have emptied your pockets of gold. No matter how much you have, you must give it all to him. In return, he will provide you will a shovel.   
Passage entrance |  |  | Even though it is dark, you should enter.   
Secret passage |  | Move | Just as the old lady instructed you to do, move Forward, Right, Left, Forward. Percy will not remember the sequence correctly, so ignore his suggestions. If you make one mistake, or interrupt your movements with another command, you will be forced to start over. Exit the passage and return inside to try again.   
Use the shovel | If you travel through the passage correctly and use the shovel, a hole will appear at the end of the tunnel, and you can see a door on the other side.   
Move forward | You will successfully sneak into the castle. Percy will drop any unnecessary items.

## Progress

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Princess_Tomato_in_the_Salad_Kingdom/Chapter_8&veaction=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Progress") | [edit source](/w/index.php?title=Princess_Tomato_in_the_Salad_Kingdom/Chapter_8&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Progress")]

Location | Appearance | Command | Description   
---|---|---|---  
Storage closet |  | Look | You will see quite a few items in the closet.   
Check the vicinity | You will notice a jar of oil and some pine tar.   
Take the oil jar | Percy will tell you that he does not know which will come in handy, but it does not matter, you need to take them in order to see what is beneath them.   
Take the pine tar   
Look | Now that you've taken the jars, you will notice a few more items, a chain and a mirror.   
Take the chain | You do not need the mirror.   
Front hallway |  |  | You will notice two doors on either side.   
Lower right door |  | Hit the door | You won't get a response at first.   
Move to go back | Just as you start to leave, a servant will open the door.   
Servant | Talk | The servant will inform you that the princess is taking a bath.   
Upper left door |  | Move to enter | This door is unlocked. You will arrive in the bathroom.   
Bathroom |  | Hit | You will strike the glass, and the orange taking a shower will poke her head out to find out what the trouble is.   
Orange | Talk | She will tell you that Princess Tomato went to take a walk in the garden.   
Rear hallway |  | Move left | You will notice two passages to the left and right, as well as three doors on the left.   
Garden |  | Look | You will notice a pond.   
Check the pond | Percy will volunteer to investigate the pond, but will start having problems when he realizes that he can't swim.   
Use the Water Wings | Percy will stop drowning, and notice an ornament at the bottom of the pond. Percy will retrieve it for you.   
Take the Water | Percy will collect some water for you.   
Rear Hallway |  | Move | Any attempt to move to any of the doors or to the right passage will result in Percy noting the shadow of a guard, and realizing that you can't get past the area without being spotted.   
Use the ornament | You will throw the ornament, but it will attract the guard rather than distract him.   
Guard | Use the Oil Jar | The guard will slip on the oil and get knocked unconscious.   
Use the chain | You will tie up the guard with the chain, and be able to proceed without getting caught.   
Upper right door |  | Use key | Now that you freed up some items in your inventory, return to the front hallway, and use the key on the upper right door.   
Locked room |  | Look | This room has not been used in a long time.   
Check the vicinity | You will notice a desk.   
Check the desk | On the desk you will find a photograph and a piece of paper.   
Check the paper | On this paper is a letter to the Pumpkin Minister from his son.   
Take the letter | You take the paper from the table.   
Check the letter | The letter discusses the marriage between the minister's son and Princess Tomato.   
Check the drawers | You will find a gold coin in one of them.   
Take the coin | Grab the coin for later.   
Prison door |  | Move to enter | You will notice that the door is locked.   
Look | Amazingly, if you look at the door, you will find the keyring right in front of the door.   
Take the keys | You must obtain them before you can use them.   
Use the keys | Naturally, you can use the keys to open the door.   
Prison | Cabbage  
Lettuce  
Garlic  
Pepper  
White Leaf | Check the vicinity | You will see the four vegetable prisoners in the cell.   
Look ×2 | You will notice a barrel in the corner of the room.   
Check the barrel ×2 | You will see a white leaf in the barrel that is withered.   
Give the Water | The White Leaf will recover.   
Talk to White Leaf | The White Leaf doubts that you can be trusted.   
Use the Crest | Showing the crest will convince the White Leaf that you're part of the resistance, and that you can be trusted.   
Talk to White Leaf | White Leaf will inform you that the son of the Pumpkin Minister is allergic to caterpillars.   
Talk to Cabbage | He will only say that he hates the minister.   
Use the Crest | Cabbage will recognize you as part of the resistance.   
Talk to Lettuce | He is sleepy.   
Check Lettuce | Lettuce is dirty and when you examine him, you will find a caterpillar.   
Talk to Lettuce | He will offer to give the caterpillar to you.   
Take the caterpillar | You will hold on to it for later.   
Talk to Green Pepper | He has some advice for you, but you must pay him to get it.   
Give the gold coin | Now Green Pepper will tell you what he knows.   
Talk to Green Pepper | He tells you a specific pattern: Rock, rock, scissors, paper, scissors, paper, paper, rock. Don't forget it.   
Front left door |  | Move to enter | Back in the rear hallway, examine the closest of the three left doors. This is the only one which will be unlocked.   
Servant's chambers | Servant |  | When you arrive, you may think you have spotted Princess Tomato at last, but it's only the servant from ealier.   
Check the right door | You will find that this door is unlocked.   
Princess' chambers |  |  | Slip into the next room and you will find this bedroom unoccupied.   
Look | You will see another door to the right, and flowers on the table.   
Move to the right door | You can try to enter through this door, but you will find that it's locked.   
Rear Hallway |  |  | To continue, you must step back outside for a moment.   
Boudoir |  |  | After you enter the hallway, come all the way back to the Princess' chambers and try the right door again. You will now be able to enter.   
Check the Stool | You may notice something unusual about it.   
Hit the Stool | It will sound hollow.   
Check the Stool ×2 | You will find a hidden compartment in the stool, and inside, you will find a diary.   
Check the Diary | It turns out to be the diary of Princess Tomato. She talks about the upcoming wedding ceremony, and her attempts to disguise herself and make herself look ugly with makeup.   
Princess' Chambers | Granny Tomato |  | Once again, you must exit out to the hallway before you return here in order to continue.   
Talk ×2 | The Granny Tomato will complain that you've entered without permission and ask who you are.   
Use the Crest | You will attempt to convince her using the crest.   
Talk ×2 | Even though you've shown her the crest, she will not be convinced.   
Princess' Chambers | Granny Tomato | Give Strange Grass | You must leave and re-enter the room to continue. When you come back, use the Strange Grass on Granny Tomato, and it will have the effect of revealing her true identity.   
Princess Tomato | Talk ×2 | Her true identity revealed, the princess won't seem too troubled that you've discovered who she is. She will tell you that you need to regain the Turnip Emblem from Minister Pumpkin.   
Minister's door | Eggplant soldier | Fight ×2 | Defeat the Eggplant soldier in Finger Wars to advance to the room beyond the door. The Eggplant soldier's weakness is that he always look up.

text:
Minister's Chambers |  | Look | You will see the throne as well as a door that lead further inside.   
Check the door | The door is unlocked.   
Move to the door | There's little else of interest in this room.   
Minister's Bedroom |  | Look | You will see a large bed, a bookshelf, a trophy, and a table.   
Check the Bookshelf | You will see many books on it.   
Take a book | You will grab one of the books.   
Check the book | The book contains a particular clue about how to proceed through a maze when you stumble upon a baby monster.   
Check the Bed | The bed will move and a flight of stairs will be revealed below it.   
Check the Stairs | Before you're ready to move through them, you will be pushed down by someone.   
Dungeon  
[](/wiki/File:PTitSK_Ch8_map.png) | Your goal in this dungeon is to locate the papa monster and defeat him in battle. In order to do this, you will first have to locate the baby monster, and then proceed through the maze in a particular fashion in order to encounter the father. Throughout the dungeon, you are likely to encounter the mama several times at various dead-ends. You begin at the square labeled **S**. 

  * **M** : These are the squares where you will encounter the mama monster. The mother monster starts with three "points," and always looks left if defeated in the rock-paper-scissors portion of Finger Wars. Whenever you win, the mother runs off to another location.
  * **B** : This is the location where you will find the baby monster. Being so young, it does not pose a threat, but you must find him first, and the traverse the dungeon in a particular way to reach the father.
  * **P** : This is where the papa monster will appear and fight you. However, in order to find him there, you must start from the baby's location, turn around, and proceed through the dungeon travelling as straight as possible, turning only when you are forced to. Along the way, you will encounter three holes in the ground who each provide a message whenever you pass them. If you arrive at the **P** in any other manner, all you will find is a breeze coming through the wall.

  
Dungeon | Papa Monster | Fight | Like the Mama Monster, the Papa Monster will only ever look left. Other than having to defeat it more times to win, it is the same. When you win, you will return to the Minister's chambers.   
Minister's Bedroom | Minister Pumpkin | Look | You will finally come face to face with Minister Pumpkin   
Fight | You must defeat the Minister in Finger Wars. You have one advantage: the clue that the Green Pepper gave you in the prison. It happens to be the strategy that the Minister uses to fight. When he reaches the end of the sequence, he starts it right back over. To counter this sequence, all you must do is use paper, paper, rock, scissors, rock, scissors, scissors, paper, and so on until you defeat him.   
Talk | After defeating the minister, he will tell you that he does not have the Turnip Emblem, and that he gave it to his son.   
Princess' Chambers | Princess Tomato | Talk ×2 | She will ask about the Turnip Emblem, but ultimately, she will agree that it's time to escape.   
Garden |  | Move to exit | You will escape from the minister's compound and return to safety with the princess.

> Princess Tomato in the Salad Kingdom 

> Join Sir Cucumber on his quest to save Princess Tomato from the evil clutches of Minister Pumpkin. From his lair in the Zucchini Mountains, Minister Pumpkin sends out his cruel farmies to terrorize innocent vegetables throughout the Salad Kingdom. For rescuing the Princess, Sir Cucumber is promised her hand and the Kingdom as well. 
> 
> Use commands to make your way through the Salad   
>  Kingdom. Move - Move to a nearby destination   
>  Look - View the area around you for important details!   
>  Check - Have a closer look for hidden objects!   
>  Talk - Talk to everyone for clues!   
>  Take - If you see something you can use, take it!   
>  Use - Use your items in the right place!   
>  Give - Give an item to others and they may give something back!     
> ---  
> Be sure to check your surroundings carefully; many hidden things and places wait to be discovered.  Buy - Trade money for items   
>  Hit - Can be used to open the way   
>  Fight - Use this when all else fails!   
>  Praise - A few kind words can go a long way   
>  Dump - Carrying too much? Use this to drop some   
>  Item - Check out what items you are carrying   
>  Percy - If you need advice, ask Percy     
> ---  
  
>   
>  Princess Tomato in the Salad Kingdom  
>  This early adventure game uses a menu of commands to interact with the world. The areas aren't overly expansive so you can always use trial and error if you are completely stumped. The game is very light hearted and humorous, following the exploits of Sir Cucumber as he travels through the Salad Kingdom in order to save Princess Tomato. 
> 
> As with most games in this genre, there isn't much action and you will instead need to rely on your wits and observational skills in order to advance. It is definitely different than most games found on the NES and isn't for those looking for fast paced action or an immersive rpg. Quirky characters and imaginative scenery dominate the landscape providing one of the most unique experiences found on the NES.
